ranked.headline: Graph-based representations with causal and RL objectives rank drugs and targets
ranked.summary: Graph-derived priors combined with causal, offline reinforcement, and variational objectives are improving drug and perturbation response prediction.

ranked.headline: Deep models encode gene modules, regulatory sequence and epigenomic context for prediction
ranked.summary: Foundation models and flow-matching predictors now target gene perturbation, promoter activity and TF binding by combining multi-source genomic inputs.

ranked.headline: Graph and deep learning methods infer regulation and tissue structure from omics data
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell multiomics demand integration methods that handle missing modalities, technology mismatch, and multi-scale regulation.

ranked.headline: Linking histology and spatial context to gene expression in spatial transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend spatial gene expression models with histology, graph weighting, regularization, and transfer learning.

ranked.headline: Computational inference from single-cell and methylation data tests biomarker reliability
ranked.summary: Single-cell, spatial and bulk sequencing datasets now support inference of metastasis-initiating cells, methylation activity and somatic mutations.

ranked.headline: Orthology-based tools enable comparative phylogenomic and proteomic analysis
ranked.summary: Scalable, usability-focused tools now link orthology, gene-tree trait profiling, and functional enrichment across large datasets.

ranked.headline: Generative models learn protein and receptor dynamics from simulation and cryo-EM data
ranked.summary: Generative sampling is now coupled to dynamical trajectories and cryo-EM density data rather than single static structures.

ranked.headline: Single-cell readouts are being tested for fidelity to underlying molecular states
ranked.summary: Preprints now model single-cell data for mtDNA dynamics and lineage, testing whether readouts faithfully reflect molecular state.

ranked.headline: Software tools for sequence variation, coevolution, and genotype-phenotype analysis
ranked.summary: Recent releases address mobile element-aware genome comparison, coevolution mapping, and RNA virus discovery from assemblies.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict protein and drug-target interaction endpoints
ranked.summary: Recent preprint and journal work applies protein language models and contrastive or Bayesian deep fusion to interaction and association prediction.

ranked.headline: Learned generators paired with synthesizability and physical constraints for molecules
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair generative, representational, and language models with rule, flow-matching, or spectral constraints for molecular tasks.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools audit cell annotation, variant classification and repurposing
ranked.summary: Recent releases expose diagnostics and benchmarks for scRNA annotation, variant classification, and drug repurposing as inspectable open code.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-resolved assemblies separate alleles in polyploid and heterozygous genomes
ranked.summary: Long-read and Hi-C phasing now yields near telomere-to-telomere autotetraploid assemblies, and allele-level analyses extend to transcripts and meiosis.

ranked.headline: Graph and factorization methods integrate multi-omics data for biomarker selection
ranked.summary: Multiomic and longitudinal datasets increasingly demand network-regularized models that handle missing modalities and correlated features.

ranked.headline: Dynamical models resolve transitions and oscillations in gene and signaling networks
ranked.summary: Mechanistic and early-warning models now predict state transitions and product yield across gene circuits, signaling, and bioprocesses.

ranked.headline: Protein language models separate stability from function and guide sequence evolution
ranked.summary: Protein language models and generative frameworks are now applied to variant effects, Cas PAM specificity, and RNA aptamer evolution.

ranked.headline: Single-cell profiling links chromatin, splicing and promoter choice to gene regulation
ranked.summary: Single-cell multiome atlases and CRISPR perturbation screens now resolve regulatory elements and isoform-level control within individual cells.

ranked.headline: Variational inference resolves alleles, haplotypes, and variant mixtures
ranked.summary: Variational and uncertainty-aware models now address polymorphic genotyping, trans-eQTL mapping, fine-mapping, and viral mixture quantification.

ranked.headline: Graph-based and long-read tools resolve strains and genomes from sequencing data
ranked.summary: Preprints and a new publication report benchmarks and pipelines for strain-resolved and long-read microbial genome analysis.

ranked.headline: Learned tissue delineation in gigapixel pathology and live-cell imaging
ranked.summary: Foundation models and parameter-efficient tuning are being applied to tissue masks, anomaly detection, and glomerulus segmentation in whole-slide imaging.

ranked.headline: Spatial pattern testing and integration methods extend spatial omics analysis
ranked.summary: Recent methods add calibrated pattern tests and imputation to spatial omics data, with scalable algorithms for large datasets.

ranked.headline: Genome structure and mutation dynamics across diverse non-model eukaryotes
ranked.summary: Chromosome-scale, pedigree-based, and reanalyzed shallow sequencing now resolve recombination, mutation rate, and structural variation in non-model species.

ranked.headline: New software tools for simulation, metabolic modeling, and multi-omics analysis
ranked.summary: Recent 2026 releases provide Python, R, and Galaxy tools for simulating regulatory networks, integrating omics modules, and scoring single-cell signatures.

ranked.headline: Population-scale CNV, STR, and oligogenic models refine variant-trait association
ranked.summary: Population-scale genomes now pair structural variants and interacting gene sets with trait association, moving beyond single common-variant models.

ranked.headline: Genome language models gain from evolutionary pretraining and benchmarked prediction
ranked.summary: Sequence-based models for genomes, enzymes, and regulatory elements are being evaluated on benchmarks, pretraining objectives, and design tasks.

ranked.headline: Simulations resolve transient conformational and electronic states in membrane proteins
ranked.summary: Recent MD, Markov state, QM/MM, and cryo-EM-integrated studies probe short-lived membrane protein states governing transport, catalysis, and electron transfer.

ranked.headline: Sample structure constrains kinship, age, and variant inference in ancient genomic data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study expose how sample composition and dating gaps bound inference in ancient DNA.

ranked.headline: Software tools extend conditional, joint and meta-analysis of GWAS to multi-ancestry data
ranked.summary: Multi-ancestry GWAS summary statistics now have faster conditional and joint analysis and accessible meta-analysis tools in recent preprints and publications.

ranked.headline: Physical priors paired with learned structure models yield conformational ensembles
ranked.summary: Energy-aware ensemble models now extend beyond single-state prediction to disordered proteins, RNA, and energetic frustration.

ranked.headline: Coarse-grained and restrained simulations map disordered protein conformational ensembles
ranked.summary: Disordered proteins need ensemble-level descriptions, and recent preprints combine experimental restraints with thermodynamically grounded coarse-graining.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking DIA and DDA workflows for label-free and chemical proteomics
ranked.summary: Multi-lab benchmarks and new DIA analysis tools address how comparable and complete MS-based protein quantification has become across platforms.

ranked.headline: In silico pathogenicity inference now spans missense and synonymous variation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and resources apply in silico pathogenicity scoring to ATG9A, TSC1/TSC2 and synonymous variants across large catalogs.

ranked.headline: Machine learning models read epigenomic marks to predict regulation and accessibility
ranked.summary: Epigenomic datasets now enable predictive models of transcription, mutation-rate variation and accessible chromatin across yeast, Arabidopsis and pangenomes.

ranked.headline: Scaling phylogenetic network estimation, parallel tree inference, and pangenome MUM…
ranked.summary: Recent work scales network estimation, parallel tree search, and multi-MUM finding to large datasets, including 474 human haplotypes.

ranked.headline: Simulations probe residue-level interactions in condensates and peptide-siRNA complexes
ranked.summary: Coarse-grained and constant-pH simulations now resolve residue-level contacts governing condensate organization and siRNA binding.

ranked.headline: Graph-based descriptors link network topology to chromatin and regulatory organization
ranked.summary: Network metrics applied to Hi-C contact graphs and gene regulatory networks offer quantitative links between topology and genome organization.

ranked.headline: Open-source and web platforms standardize analysis and plotting of biological data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints release software for standardizing EV measurements, exploring transcriptomic cohorts, and generating plots from natural-language commands.

ranked.headline: Computational single-cell and mass spectrometry methods advance antibody characterization
ranked.summary: Open platforms and benchmarks now address antibody panel design, de novo sequencing, and affinity prediction from single-cell data.
